verdict.rationale: Featurebase markets 'Fibi AI agent' to auto-resolve customer issues and an AI feature to declutter/prioritize feedback, which fits delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. However, evidence is limited to marketing taglines with no docs on configuration, task scope, or hands-on/independent verification of how delegation actually works. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of Fibi's capabilities/limits, user-facing setup instructions, independent or hands-on validation of task delegation working as claimed.
